chunks: Take a lesson from what was from the action of Allah with Satan,

when He nullified his long work and his strenuous effort, and he had worshipped Allah for six thousand years, it is not known whether from the years of this world or the years of the Hereafter, for the greatness of one hour.
So who after Satan will be safe from Allah by committing a similar disobedience?
No, it was not for Allah, Glorified is He, to let a human being enter Paradise by an action that He expelled from it an angel.
Indeed His command for the people of the sky and the people of the earth is one,
and there is no friendship between Allah and any of His creation to give license for an undesirable thing which He has held unlawful for the worlds.
ai.seo_question: How did Satan's long worship become nullified by a single moment?
ai.summary: Imam Ali uses Iblis as the archetype of vanity to warn that prolonged devotion does not guarantee immunity from divine judgment if pride corrupts the heart. This passage underscores the Shia principle of divine justice (Adl), emphasizing that the criteria for entry into Paradise or expulsion from it are uniform for both angels and humans, with no arbitrary favoritism. It serves as a cautionary tale against the subtle vice of self-righteousness that can nullify years of worship.

en.sayed-ali-raza: You should take a lesson from what Allāh did with Satan;

namely He nullified his great acts and extensive efforts on account of the vanity of one moment, although Satan had worshipped Allāh for six thousand years - whether by the reckoning of this world or of the next world is not known.
Who now can remain safe from Allāh after Satan by committing a similar disobedience?
None at all. Allāh, the Glorified, cannot let a human being enter Paradise if he does the same thing for which Allāh turned out from it an angel.
His command for the inhabitants in the sky and of the earth is the same.
There is no friendship between Allāh and any individual out of His creation so as to give him license for an undesirable thing which He has held unlawful for all the worlds.
